items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: I was out here at the Persian Pettis with Dave... Dave could fight but we couldn't quit. Cause Dave was trying to keep us from going back down to the plantation with Joe.

ctx.x: I mean they used music though, they didn't just play with the ear in Paris.

That's right, that's right. Yeah. Now you see, Charlie was playing on the same pole and Faith Marable with Lois Armstrong and Baby Dots, Johnny Sincere, Dave Jones, oh this other clarinet player, trumpet player. He was playing the first trumpet player. He was playing saxophone now, he lives in Milwaukee now. Oh, I don't remember. It would come across from the mind.
Yeah, was Pop Foster in the band then too, bass player? Yeah, Pop Foster and Pop Foss was playing bass.
